audience: resource planners and project managers who book people and track hours in Resource Guru

useCases.title: See who is booked next week
useCases.text: List the accounts to get the subdomain. Then list the bookings in a date range, with the downtimes of the same period.

useCases.title: Find resources with available hours
useCases.text: Get the utilization report for a date range, with the scheduled, available and overtime hours of each resource. Then list the resources.

useCases.title: Total the logged hours per project
useCases.text: List the projects, then get the timesheet report by project for a date range. Set approved_only to count approved entries only.

useCases.title: Book a resource on a project
useCases.text: Create a booking for one or more resources, with minutes per day. A clash returns the vendor's error, because the tool never books overtime or a waiting list. Then read the booking.
